name: Zephyr
source: A clumsy man who loves surfing. He is incredible at riding waves but cannot seem to be able to walk without tripping. [spoiler]His species actually lives in water as they were persecuted on land in the past. He uses a special bracelet to become human, and his real form is more fish-like. He is very concerned with the destruction of the environment. He has a crush on the protagonist as they are kind and patient towards him.[/spoiler]
